paragraphs.text: Laksha is a young human artificer who is part of the Renegades on Avishkar . She is one of Depala 's Derby Crows.

During the fight against Tezzeret and his Consulate forces, Laksha showed Jace Beleren an opening inside Ukti's hideout that he had missed on his initial read of the room. Laksha had to duck to pass through the small doorframe, and Jace, Kari Zev and Depala were only able to crowd around behind her and look out at Laksha. She huddled over an apparatus that was perched on a modest platform clinging to the attic's exterior, but she didn't seem to mind the tight squeeze. When she pushed her way back into the attic, she indicated that the others should look through her spyglass apparatus, a collection of lenses fixed in a brass frame. When it was Jace's turn to peer through them, he saw the enormity of Skysovereign , a massive warship that hung heavy in the air, as well as scores of smaller escort ships that orbited the flagship. After that, no one said anything for a while, and the only sound was Laksha moving the gear door back into place.

As part of Depala's Derby Crew, Laksha participated in the sky battle between the Heart of Kiran and the Skysovereign , which ended with the latter ship listing to the ground from damage done by a swooping Aethertide Whale .
